svg.aria-label: Skills. Flutter for the apps, TypeScript and Java for the servers, and C++ close to the system. Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin, Capacitor. Backend and data: TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, SQLite. Systems: C++20, Linux, CMake, Docker. Web: React, Next.js, Angular, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, WebGL2, Electron. Testing and delivery: Flutter tests, Vitest, Playwright, JUnit, Fuzzing and sanitizers, GitHub Actions, App Store and Google Play releases. Also: Python, Vertex AI and Gemini, MediaPipe, Git.
